method: Built-in OpenAI ImageGen, requested genuine transparent alpha. New art; the board is style reference only, not sampled sprite pixels.
reference: Exact pinned Wasteland Academy overworld-wide board concept at navrefs/overworld-wide.webp. Proof composited over original 1080×1920 portrait board.
production: Tight alpha-aware production trim and resampling preserved RGBA; compatibility animation sheets constructed from these sprite transforms. Original generated sources preserved separately.

tumbleweed.prompt: Game sprite. A dry round tumbleweed in 3/4 overhead orthographic view as if seen on the ground in the map, a roughly spherical mesh of pale straw and burnt sienna twigs with a more solid dark core, bright warm edges with restrained dark ink, small transparent holes visible between bold 7–12 outer twig shapes. Distinct asymmetric notch and a fork of longer branches on one side so rotation reads. Center it on its geometric center. No sweeping wind marks or dust. It will physically roll from a center pivot. Style reference: the supplied landscape is mood, palette and ink-language only, never a backdrop or something to cut out. Match that rusty terra-cotta, hand-painted dark-ink graphic-novel Wasteland Academy board game. The result is a newly invented standalone game sprite in straight RGBA with a genuinely transparent background; no ground, no sky, no letters, no labels, no border, no drop shadow, generous clear margin, one subject only. Major forms must read when small in a richly textured map.
